## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] If the on-disk format, the write protocol or an exit code changed: `docs/protocol.md` and the changelog are updated
- [ ] No new dependency, or its license is GPLv3-compatible
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
